reason: A is the stronger, more directly testable proposal because composition tuning can plausibly alter both electronic and lattice thermal transport, whereas B relies on large phonon-transport anisotropy from texturing a cubic metallic alloy whose high-temperature conductivity is likely dominated by electrons and chemical-disorder scattering. A remains risky—Ni may increase alloy scattering or destabilize the BCC phase—but its controlled substitution experiment can decisively test those effects.
